label: TP
reason: User-controlled input from HTTP parameters flows directly to response.getWriter().format() without sanitization. The param variable (tainted source at line 46) is assigned to bar (line 50) and passed as the format string argument to writer.format() at line 54. Format string vulnerabilities occur because %specifiers in user input control the format operation.

evidence.note: User input extracted from request.getParameterMap() flows through doSomething() and reaches format() sink without sanitization
response.getWriter().format(bar, obj) - format string controlled by tainted user input
